newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Topstyle in HK$13 mln share option loan.
newsitem.headline: Topstyle in HK$13 mln share option loan.

text.p: Silk garment maker Topstyle International Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it had entered into a loan agreement to borrow HK$13 million, carrying an interest rate of 1.0 percent per annum, from third party licensed money lender Silver Ocean Finance Co Ltd.

The loan, to be repaid on June 30, 1997, also gives Silver Ocean an option to convert the loan into 68.42 million new shares, or 15.26 percent of Topstyle's expanded share capital, at HK$0.19 per share, the company said.
Topstyle said the loan was conditional on the stock exchange granting approval for dealing in the option shares. It said the loan would be used as additional working capital.
Topstyle shares were untraded at HK$0.20 each at midday.
